# Orchestration v1

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's orchestration/v1 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.OrchestrationV1(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.orchestration`).

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.OrchestrationV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Stacks.Resources().List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Stacks.Resources().Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.

## Resources

| Service field | API package | Common policies and scope |
|---|---|---|
| `APIVersions` | [apiversions](apiversions/api_generated.go) | API operations; no common Collection policies |
| `BuildInfo` | [buildinfo](buildinfo/api_generated.go) | API operations; no common Collection policies |
| `Resourcetypes` | [resourcetypes](resourcetypes/api_generated.go) | API operations; no common Collection policies |
| `StackEvents` | [stackevents](stackevents/api_generated.go) | `InStack(ctx, ref) / ForStack(identity)`: stack/resource event lists and resource_name+eventID reads; no name Find/mutations/waits |
| `StackResources` | [stackresources](stackresources/api_generated.go) | `InStack(ctx, ref) / ForStack(identity)`: resource_name reads, lists, name resolution, metadata, health, waits; verifies actual nested owners |
| `Stacks` | [stacks](stacks/api_generated.go) | `Resources() / InStack(ctx, ref) / ForStack(identity)`: ID reads, lists, name lookup, deletion/deletion waits, status waits |
| `StackTemplates` | [stacktemplates](stacktemplates/api_generated.go) | API operations; no common Collection policies |

Shared rules for options, name lookup, listing, parent scopes, waits and microversions are in [common operations](../../docs/common-operations.md), [finding identities](../../docs/finding-identities.md), [listing](../../docs/listing.md), [scoped resources](../../docs/scoped-resources.md), [service waits](../../docs/service-waits.md) and [microversions](../../docs/microversions.md).
